name: Wait anchor (organizer cases and on-demand trips)
statement: Organizer profile: the wait starts at trip_data.driver_wait_start. Ryde profile, on-demand: the wait starts when the driver presses "I'm Here", provided the driver is at the pick-up point according to GPS (CW-R06).

params.name: WAIT_ANCHOR_FIELD
params.value: driver_arrived event ('I'm Here') with GPS at pickup

sources.quote: waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
